question: How much is delayed feedback worth when it changes an actual protected-frame action? Independent follow-up motivated by the frozen-JSCC results.
input: Previously measured NeST N1024 pilot. Use every cell of 100 calibration images x 4 actual AWGN SNRs (4/7/10/19 dB) x 300 legal actions (12 MCS x 25 caps). Each source has one original channel draw 4101. Use stored DINOv2 cosine and received status, including original fixed gray on rejection/NULL. Exactly audit all four-by-300 aggregate scores/failures/NULLs against the published pilot CSV before analysis.
source_split: First 50 full IDs in increasing SHA256(UTF8('digital-feedback-20261123|' + source_id)) are calibration. Remaining 50 are pseudo-held-out for this replay; all 100 are from the old pilot and have been studied before. Never choose a policy using those latter 50 outcomes.
state_model: At each image slot the discrete AWGN state is retained with probability p, otherwise drawn uniformly among all four states (including the same state). Stationary state uniform; p in [0.60,0.95]. A report measures the past discrete state or its coarse group without error. At age d the conditional state law is p^d times the posterior under no reset plus (1-p^d)/4. These are modeled joint probabilities over previously measured memoryless frames, not measured temporal transitions.
actions: A one-bit group is {4,7} or {10,19}; two bits identify the state. With a two-slot report interval the delivered report age alternates 2/3. For each mode, age, report and p, select the public candidate maximizing training-image mean DINOv2 cosine under the conditional state distribution; exact ties (within 1e-12) use ascending candidate ID. Both ends have the same public action table, feedback symbols, schedule and delay, so can identify the chosen existing directory. No extra per-image mode bit or image at RX is assumed. Payload bits only; synchronized error-free feedback.
outcome: Exact marginalization over stationary true state, received report and reporting phase. Report equally weighted per-source expected cosine and rejection-or-NULL fraction, direct paired differences and 5000 percentile bootstrap intervals on the same 50 sources, conditional on this calibration split and state model. Instantaneous variants are references. No redraw of channel noise, PHY, reconstructions or metrics.
primary: One bit every slot versus two bits every two slots at equal reverse payload; each versus static. Disclose worse quality/rejection in either persistence condition. Averaged outcomes and per-true-SNR breakdown are retained.
